window-class.$description: The window classes, after Material's: the container widths where each class starts, compact below medium. envUI measures them on a container, never on the viewport: the theme boundary is the env-window container. CSS can't read a custom property inside @container, so style sheets write the value itself; these tokens and the windowClasses constant hold the same widths.

medium.$description: 37.5 rem: where medium starts, such as a tablet held upright or a narrow desktop window; narrower is compact, such as a phone.

expanded.$description: 52.5 rem: where expanded starts, such as a tablet held sideways.

large.$description: 75 rem: where large starts, such as a desktop window.
